name: Hendra house
note: New house with a carport, front porch, balcony and rear alfresco, a picket front fence and batten gates. Modelled from the architectural drawings and site survey.

name: Bardon house
note: Large hillside house with wide roof overhangs and a pool, on terraced ground. Modelled from the architectural drawings, cropped to the house and set at 30 degrees to fit the printer.

name: Ferny Hills house
note: Highset weatherboard house on a sloping block. Built from the listing floor plan, Queensland Government LiDAR ground levels and photos of the house.

name: Mitchelton house
note: Post-war weatherboard house with a tiled hip roof, lattice entry porch, sunken back courtyard and fences. Ground, walls and roof levels from a detail and level survey; street side from a photo.
